structures.label: Future: will
structures.example: I think it will take about three months.

structures.label: Future: going to
structures.example: We are going to move in September.

structures.label: Future continuous
structures.example: This time next week I will be sitting on a train.

structures.label: Future perfect
structures.example: By June I will have finished the migration.

structures.label: Past simple
structures.example: I left at seven and got there late.

structures.label: Past continuous
structures.example: I was reviewing the code when the call came.

structures.label: Past perfect
structures.example: The deadline had already passed when I noticed.

structures.label: used to
structures.hint: used to + infinitive, for discontinued states and habits
structures.example: I used to commute two hours a day.

structures.label: would (habitual past)
structures.hint: would + infinitive for repeated past actions
structures.example: Every summer we would drive to the coast.
structures.detect: would + VB in past narrative context

structures.label: Zero conditional
structures.example: If a meeting has no agenda, it runs long.

structures.label: First conditional
structures.example: If the build fails, I will roll it back.

structures.label: Second conditional
structures.example: If I had more time, I would rewrite it.

structures.label: Third conditional
structures.hint: if + had + past participle, would have + past participle
structures.example: If I had asked earlier, I would have saved a week.
structures.detect: if + had + VBN, would|could|might + have + VBN

structures.label: Mixed conditional
structures.example: If I had studied law, I would be in a different city now.
structures.detect: if + had + VBN, would + VB (present reference)

structures.label: Speculation: present
structures.example: She must be stuck in traffic.

structures.label: Speculation: past
structures.hint: must / might / could have + past participle
structures.example: He might have forgotten the meeting.

structures.label: Passive voice
structures.example: The parts are assembled in three factories.

structures.label: Reported speech
structures.example: He said he had already sent it.

structures.label: Relative clauses
structures.hint: who / which / whose / that, defining and non-defining
structures.example: The colleague whose desk faces the window never uses it.

structures.label: Gerund vs infinitive
structures.hint: verb patterns: avoid doing, plan to do, keep doing, refuse to do
structures.example: I keep postponing it because I refuse to admit it is stuck.

structures.label: wish / if only
structures.hint: wish + past for present regret, wish + past perfect for past regret
structures.example: I wish I had said no at the start.
